provenance.network_hash_definition: canonical XML excluding generator timestamp/path comments and insignificant whitespace
provenance.verification: real SUMO execution; benchmark interpretation requires evaluation gates

audit.scope: Artifact consistency and legal schedule timings; not visual QA or traffic-performance superiority

civilian_excess_p95_population.reference: saved demand external-lane free-flow lower bound; excludes internal junctions and acceleration

outcomes.civilian_reference_definition: max(0, arrival - scheduled_departure - external SUMO lane free-flow lower bound); reference excludes internal junctions and acceleration
outcomes.trip_time_source: SUMO tripinfo departure/arrival; list-event discovery timestamps retained separately

analytical.limitation: Bounds apply only to the aggregate equal-service surrogate, not traffic guarantees. Incoming-edge queues may include other turns; occupancy is route-averaged. Ignores individual phase age, min-green residual, clipped request schedules and future arrivals. Civilian penalty is uncalibrated, not a measured all-demand mean. No empirical gain claimed.

observation.eta_formula: dispatch + external lane free-flow time + 2 seconds per observed queued route vehicle; frozen
